## Mission check

Which verb does this change strengthen? Tick at least one, or "none" for
maintenance.

- [ ] **Vary**: more or better-grounded variation, each draw recorded
- [ ] **Measure**: a property measured on what was generated, shipped with the asset
- [ ] **Prove**: a physical test in a named engine, or a validator
- [ ] None: maintenance (CI, docs, packaging) that changes no asset

And all of these hold:

- [ ] The base layer is still plain OpenUSD, readable without an engine overlay
- [ ] It runs on CPU
- [ ] CI checks the acceptance criterion (test added or updated)
- [ ] The limit that remains is written in the README's Limits section
- [ ] If the file format changed, `docs/contract.md` in primvaria changed first
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under Unreleased
